crossRefs.note: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
translations.bsb: So the Philistines took dirt and stopped up all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham.
translations.kjv: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.
translations.asv: Now all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
